title: Tsat language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Hainan, China
extract: Tsat, also known as Utsat, Utset, Hainan Cham, or Huihui, is an Austronesian language spoken by 4,500 Utsul people in the Huihui and Huixin villages near the city of Sanya in Hainan, China.
